description: Analyzes structural risk of a Solana token from on-chain data: real-holder concentration with bonding-curve and liquidity-pool accounts excluded, presence of known sniper-bot addresses among early buyers, and a simulated buy/sell round trip to detect honeypot behavior. Returns: verdict (LOW_RISK, ELEVATED, HIGH_RISK, CRITICAL, UNKNOWN), stable reason codes, and top-holder percentages. Scope is structural only; it does not detect risk that exists purely in trading behavior.
name: check_token_safety
title: Check Token Structural Risk
